newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina says oil contractors to spend $1.03 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina says oil contractors to spend $1.03 bln.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Thursday oil contractors will spend $1.03 billion for exploration in 1997, compared with $586.7 million in 1996.

"According to planning, oil contractors will spend $1.03 billion for exploration in 1997, compared with $586.7 million in 1996. This is a good sign for exploration development in 1997," Pertamina's junior exploration director F.X. Suyanto told Reuters.
He said total spending by oil contractors was expected to rise to $5.34 billion from $4.21 billion in 1996.
"The total spending includes exploration, production, development and administration," Suyanto said.
